nodes.label: Host-Network Hardened Containers
nodes.rationale: network_mode: host keeps loopback PostgreSQL reachable without exposing 5432 to a Docker subnet; traded network isolation for read-only rootfs, cap_drop ALL, non-root user, pids/mem/cpu limits and tmpfs-only writable dirs.

nodes.label: master-control-functions (project identity)
nodes.rationale: GitHub repo renamed from Web_Program_Functions_Database to master-control-functions; configs, docs, env examples and package names updated to the new identity while the webprogfndb Go module and deployment IDs were deliberately preserved.

nodes.label: Ubuntu Blue-Green Deployment
nodes.rationale: Zero-downtime releases via two persistent slots; both slots stay running after a release for rollback; script refuses to proceed when configured/live routing disagree; failure restores previous upstream file.

nodes.label: Build Network Access
nodes.rationale: Keep TLS verification and Go checksum verification enabled; GOPROXY comma-fallback triggers only on HTTP 404/410 so a connection reset will not trigger direct downloads; public-mirror retries cannot repair a host network policy blocking every mirror.

nodes.label: chmod 600 deploy/.env guard (blue-green.sh L153)
nodes.rationale: Mode 600 protects credentials with owner read/write only; blue-green.sh L153 stat guard must equal 600; chmod +x on the script changes only script permissions, not deploy/.env; synthetic check rejects 644/640 and accepts 600.

nodes.norm_label: backend-only goproxy arg with proxy forwarding
nodes.rationale: Added backend-only GOPROXY ARG with official default; deployment forwards set HTTP/HTTPS/NO_PROXY and lowercase equivalents by argument name without printing values or declaring them in the Dockerfile, preserving Docker's default exclusion from image history; no runtime dependencies.

nodes.label: deploy/.env (credentials)
nodes.rationale: Holds rotated PostgreSQL password in PGPASSWORD; kept owner-readable only (600); build settings here are not loaded into the script's shell.

nodes.label: deploy/.env.proxy (build proxy settings)
nodes.rationale: Separate from deploy/.env because Compose loads .env into application containers at runtime; proxy exports are forwarded by the script to Docker as build secrets exposed only to network-reaching build steps, never appearing on the command line, in image history, or in build cache metadata.

nodes.label: Database TLS and Loopback Policy
nodes.rationale: sslmode=disable is same-host loopback only; anything remote requires verify-full with PGSSLROOTCERT private CA; never weaken pg_hba to trust or expose 5432; credentials never enter logs, frontend bundles or git.

nodes.label: Native systemd Deployment (alternative)
nodes.rationale: Non-root webprogfndb service with root-owned /etc/master-control-functions/backend.env; random high ports: Go 24993 loopback, backend Nginx 39063, frontend Nginx 31627; remains the alternative to the Docker blue-green path.

nodes.label: deploy/tests/blue-green.test.mjs rollout tests
nodes.rationale: Replace Docker and HTTP commands with fakes and never start services or access a database; passing mocked tests do not establish real zero-downtime behavior or measured performance.

nodes.label: --migration-verified flag
nodes.rationale: An operator assertion that the transfer passed; it does not perform or independently prove migration.

nodes.label: Routing-only Rollback
nodes.rationale: Rollback changes application routing only and does not reverse migrations or restore data; schema changes must support old and new binaries concurrently; after new PostgreSQL writes the SQLite snapshot is stale and there is no automatic SQLite fallback.

nodes.label: Go 1.27.1 Toolchain (golang:1.27.1-alpine)
nodes.rationale: Host Go 1.22 from the package inventory is too old for the tagged migration build.

nodes.label: migrate-sqlite transfer tool (cmd/migrate-sqlite)
nodes.rationale: Separate transfer tool containing the legacy SQLite reader; deliberately never copied into the application image so the runtime image stays PostgreSQL-client-only.

nodes.label: master_control_functions_test Disposable Test Database
nodes.rationale: Disposable database for the same role so tagged regressions never touch the production catalog; full UI E2E reset also requires its own disposable database.

nodes.label: Existing PostgreSQL (127.0.0.1:5432)
nodes.rationale: Stable database kept outside Compose; reachable through loopback only, never opened to a Docker subnet.

nodes.label: sqlite_migration build tag
nodes.rationale: Normal builds exclude the SQLite engine; the tag gates the transfer tool and its regressions and is used only on the approved Ubuntu host.

nodes.label: Consistent SQLite v6 Snapshot (catalog-snapshot.db)
nodes.rationale: Transfer requires a consistent version-6 snapshot staged with WAL/SHM companions; a main-file copy without required WAL data is not a valid snapshot; original SQLite files remain untouched as rollback evidence.

nodes.label: Linux Host Networking
nodes.rationale: Chosen so the database remains reachable through loopback without opening PostgreSQL to a Docker subnet; trade-off is reduced network isolation, compensated by private ports, non-root processes, dropped capabilities, and read-only filesystems.

nodes.label: Bun Frontend Builder (Docker build stage)
nodes.rationale: Windows `bun --bun run build` stalled at SSR startup while the Node-backed build completed, so Docker uses Bun only as installer/runner over the canonical pnpm lockfile while retaining Node 24 tooling in the builder; the temporary Bun lockfile exists only inside the build stage to avoid a second repository lockfile.

nodes.label: Non-root Alpine Runtime Image
nodes.rationale: Contains only the Go executable, frontend files and CA certificates; neither Bun nor Node runs in production.

nodes.label: Attachments ({@attach})
nodes.rationale: Functions that run in an effect when an element mounts and when state read inside them updates, with optional cleanup; fully reactive unlike actions, and a neater alternative to $effect for syncing state to external libraries such as D3.

nodes.label: Await expressions
nodes.rationale: As of Svelte 5.36 await works at script top level, inside $derived and in markup; experimental behind the experimental.async option whose flag will be removed in Svelte 6.

nodes.label: Function bindings
nodes.rationale: bind:property={get, set} allows validation and transformation of bound values; readonly bindings pass null as the get function. Available since Svelte 5.9.0.

nodes.label: hydratable API
nodes.rationale: Serializes server-rendered async results so the client reuses them during hydration instead of redoing the work; also stabilizes random or time-based values between server rendering and hydration; powers remote functions in SvelteKit.

nodes.label: $inspect rune
nodes.rationale: Development-only reactive console.log equivalent that re-runs on deep state changes and prints stack traces; becomes a noop in production builds.

nodes.label: Snippets ({#snippet})
nodes.rationale: Reusable markup chunks with lexical scoping that replace deprecated slots; passable to components as props (explicit, implicit or children) and typeable via the Snippet interface; top-level snippets can be exported from script module.

nodes.label: createSubscriber
nodes.rationale: Integrates external event-based systems (MediaQuery, IntersectionObserver, WebSocket) with Svelte reactivity; start runs once across all reading effects and teardown fires when all are destroyed.

nodes.label: Context API (createContext)
nodes.rationale: Scope state to the part of the app that needs it and eliminate the possibility of it leaking between users during server-side rendering; createContext is preferred over setContext/getContext for type safety.

nodes.label: $derived rune
nodes.rationale: Compute from state with $derived rather than $effect; deriveds are writable and re-evaluate when their expression changes; use $derived.by when the expression is complex.

nodes.label: $effect rune
nodes.rationale: Effects are an escape hatch and should mostly be avoided; never update state inside effects and never wrap them in if (browser) because effects do not run on the server.

nodes.label: $inspect.trace
nodes.rationale: Debugging tool for reactivity: add as the first line of an $effect or $derived.by to trace which reactive dependency triggered the re-run.

nodes.label: $props rune
nodes.rationale: Treat props as though they will change: values that depend on props should usually be $derived so they update when the prop changes.

nodes.label: $state.raw
nodes.rationale: Trade-off: deep reactivity proxies objects for fine-grained updates at a performance cost; use $state.raw for large objects that are only ever reassigned rather than mutated, such as API responses.

nodes.label: $state rune
nodes.rationale: Only for variables that must be reactive (drive an $effect, $derived or template update); objects and arrays are made deeply reactive via proxies, which carries performance overhead.

nodes.label: Attachment factories
nodes.rationale: A function that returns an attachment re-creates it whenever its arguments or read state change, because the factory call itself runs inside an effect.

nodes.label: Synchronized updates
nodes.rationale: Dependent state changes are not reflected in the UI until async work completes so the UI is never left inconsistent; fast updates can overlap with slower in-flight ones.

nodes.label: Keyed each blocks
nodes.rationale: A unique key lets Svelte insert, move and delete list items surgically instead of updating DOM of existing items; keys must uniquely identify items (never the index) and destructuring should be avoided when mutating items.

nodes.label: CSP nonce for hydration script
nodes.rationale: hydratable injects an inline script into head; under CSP pass a nonce for dynamically rendered responses or hashes for pre-generated static HTML (nonce preferred as hashes interfere with future streaming SSR).

nodes.label: CSS custom properties for styling
nodes.rationale: Component CSS is scoped, so parents control child styles through CSS custom properties (style:-- directive or --color props) and use :global only as a fallback for library components.

nodes.label: Event attributes (onclick)
nodes.rationale: Any element attribute starting with on is an event listener; attach window/document listeners with <svelte:window>/<svelte:document> instead of onMount or $effect.

nodes.label: Runes mode
nodes.rationale: Always use runes mode for new code and prefer modern replacements over legacy features: $state over implicit reactivity, $derived/$effect over $:, $props over export let, onclick over on:click, snippets over slots, {@attach} over use:action, classes with $state fields over stores.

nodes.label: svelte-file-editor agent
nodes.rationale: Specialized Svelte 5 editor agent: fetch relevant documentation, then validate every change with svelte-autofixer until no issues remain; falls back to the svelte-code-writer skill or npx @sveltejs/mcp when MCP tools are unavailable.

nodes.label: svelte-code-writer skill
nodes.rationale: CLI fallback providing the same documentation lookup and autofixer tooling as the Svelte MCP server; always run svelte-autofixer before finalizing any Svelte component.
